lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 5-6 discernible vertical columns and 3-4 horizontal rows along the mid-flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular spots, forming a coordinate-like grid system where spots serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible; the uppermost ridge shows the sharpest vertical luminance gradient, separating the darker dorsal surface from the lighter mid-flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 5-7 smaller, lower-intensity circular blobs scattered across the leading and middle sections of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct concave indentation or notch is visible on the posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense clustering of minute, high-frequency white spots located specifically on the distal portion and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
